name: Geführte Sternenwanderung
beschreibung:
The entry describes a guided star hike in the Zillertal. According to the entry, participants learn about the starry sky over the Alps during a night hike with certified guides. The focus is on observing shooting stars, planets, and the Milky Way away from light pollution. The tour lasts 2–3 hours, costs 45 euros, and is said to be suitable for families with children aged 10 and up.

The Zillertal is one of the best-known side valleys of the Inntal in Tyrol, stretching from Jenbach in the north to the glaciated peaks of the Zillertal Alps in the south. Towns such as Mayrhofen, Fügen-Kaltenbach, Stumm, and Zell am Ziller lie in the valley. Large parts belong to the Zillertal Alps High Mountain Nature Park. The region is considered comparatively dark and low in light, making it well suited for stargazing.
